summary: Poppler repository update completed with PDF regression checks
changes: Completed a full pacman system upgrade. Only poppler, poppler-glib and poppler-qt6 changed, from 26.08.0-1.1 to 26.10.0-1.1. Prepared a read-only Btrfs snapshot before installation. No packages were added or removed. ChatGPT, KDE, keyboard preferences, repository configuration, graphics drivers and existing jobs were preserved. No reboot or service restart was requested.
tests: Before and after: pacman dependency/database check passed; detailed file integrity checks passed for all three packages with zero altered files. Synthetic one-page PDF passed metadata inspection, text extraction, PNG rendering and GLib document opening; Qt6 library loading and shared-library dependency resolution passed. Before/after rendered PNG checksums matched. All 29 selected configuration checksums were unchanged. No failed system units. Fresh repository update check returned no pending updates. Final package inventory comparison confirmed exactly the three expected upgrades. Required package signatures and existing administrative-directory permissions remained unchanged. GUI applications, games and performance were not tested.
rollback: A read-only Btrfs root-subvolume snapshot containing the previous package files and package database was prepared and verified. For a confirmed regression, restore the three packages and their matching package database records together from the snapshot, accounting for added files and intervening transactions; repeat linker, package database, integrity and PDF checks. No rollback was needed; restoration was not exercised. Avoid reverting unrelated files or user data.
problem: Routine available repository updates. The package manager also reported that the installed libclc version 23.1.3-3 is newer than repository version 23.1.3-2; no downgrade was performed. No reproducible CachyOS-specific defect was established.
solution: Installed the three updates through the standard full-system package transaction after confirming its exact targets and completing package key and integrity checks.
reproduction: Not applicable to an upstream defect. Validation used a locally generated synthetic single-page PDF with a fixed text string before and after the update.
